main_text.p: חצף Ch. Urfit, Acceleravit: Item Durum, obfirmatum, audacem, impudentem esse. Aphel אחציף Idem: Item Obfirmare, indurare. Part. מחצפה Accelerans erat, Daniel.3.22. & cum ה characteristico מהחצפה, Dan.2.15.
חציפא, חציף Ch. Obfirmatus, protervus, impudens, audax, temerarius.
חוצפא Ch.Obfirmatio, impudentia, temeritas, Num. 16.2. in Jon. & Jerem.33. Jobi 30.12.
ܚܨܦܐ [?] Syr. Testa, idem quod חספא [?] In vasis testae, i. testaceis, argillaceis, 2.ad Cor.4.7.
חצין Ch.Ejaculari, Pahel Part. מחצצי נירא Ejaculantes sagittas, h.e. Sagittarii, Jud.5.8.
חצוצרתא Ch. Tuba. Plur. חצוצרן, emphatice הצוצרתא.
חצר חצר Ch.Atrium. Hinc Ch. חצרא Reticulum jecoris, quasi ejus atrium, Levit.3.15.
חציר Chald. Gramen, Foenum. Hinc כחציר אנריא Sicut gramen tectorum, Psal.129.6.
חקל חקלא Ch.& Syr. Ager, Campus: ܚܩܠܐ [?] Ager sanguinis, Aceldema, Act.1.19. Plural. masc. חקלין: & foem. חקלתא.
חקק Ch.Exsculpere, exprimere, exarare, incidere, insculpere. Ithpahel Partic. מתחקק Exsculptū, Exod.20.2. in Jon.
חקר Hebr. Scrutari, perscrutari. Hinc Chald. Inf. למחקר ית קרתא Ad perscrutandū urbem, 2.Samuel.10.3. Partic. חקר לבא Perscrutans cor, Jerem. 17.10. Imper. חקרני perscrutare me, Ps.139.23.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed from the scan; the vocalised forms are uncertain and marked [?] where the points or letters are hard to read. The Syriac entry at the start of the Syr. Testa line is only approximate.
